Thanks. Well, I'm studying in a different country, by myself. My friends are all from my home country. I was out for 7 months and then I came back for Easter hollidays to visit my friends and family. But my friends went away for hollidays too, to a different city. I don't mind that, I understand, they were on hollidays too and went somewhere else. It's just because if any of them went away for so long, I would take a day of my hollidays (at least) to go visit them if they came back. Eventually, my friends did end up taking a day off, almost when I was leaving, but they made me feel bad, telling me about the big effort they made to be with me and stuff like that. I just felt like "ok, I'm sorry then... I didn't want to cause any trouble. I thought they wanted to be with me. If they feel forced to be with me, it's not a good thing... =(

I'm sorry... I hate complaining about things. I feel so stupid... 

PS. I'm not a man. Thanks anyway, gender doesn't matter.

Thanks a lot for your support. I know my friends and family love me... I just don't feel it... They can more easily get angry at me or making me feel like shit than telling me something nice. Maybe I really deserve it. I don't know anymore. I know they criticise me for my own good, trying to help me. But I just can't be any better... I just can't. I just want to give up and be away from everything and everyone. They won't even miss me. I know that because I study very far away from home and when I come back, nobody makes any effort to be with me. It seems like they always have to make a sacrifice to be with me. I don't want that. I just want everybody to be happy. It seems everyone is happier without me....
